title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
constraints: At most one buy-and-sell transaction is allowed, with buying before selling.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 2 (price=1), sell on day 5 (price=6). Profit = 6-1 = 5.
Buy at 2 and sell at 4; the later lower price cannot be used for an earlier sale.

solutionApproaches.title: Compare Every Buy and Sell Day
solutionApproaches.explanation: Try each buy day with every later sell day. It is correct but repeats the same price comparisons.

solutionApproaches.title: Single Pass Min Tracking
solutionApproaches.explanation: Track the minimum price seen so far; at each step update max profit.
